medications.purpose: Blood pressure control and renal protection
medications.nice_justification: NICE NG136 recommends ACE‑I as first‑line therapy for hypertension in non‑Afro‑Caribbean adults <55 y or any age when no contraindication (step 1).

medications.purpose: Add‑on therapy to achieve BP target <140/90 mmHg
medications.nice_justification: NICE NG136 step 2 recommends ACE‑I + CCB combination when monotherapy is insufficient.

medications.dose: 80 mg once daily in the evening
medications.purpose: Reduce LDL (target >40 % reduction) and lower ASCVD risk
medications.nice_justification: NICE CG181/CG181‑update advises high‑intensity statin for LDL > 100 mg/dL or high cardiovascular risk.

medications.dose: 500 mg twice daily (after 1 week of 500 mg once daily)
medications.purpose: Prevent progression from pre‑diabetes to type 2 diabetes
medications.nice_justification: NICE NG28 recommends metformin for high‑risk pre‑diabetes when lifestyle measures alone are insufficient.

interactions_checked.interaction: Additive blood‑pressure lowering effect; risk of symptomatic hypotension.
interactions_checked.action: Check BP after 2 weeks; reduce lisinopril dose if symptomatic hypotension occurs.

interactions_checked.interaction: Amlodipine can increase atorvastatin plasma concentrations via CYP3A4 inhibition, raising myopathy risk.
interactions_checked.action: Monitor CK and symptoms of myopathy; consider rosuvastatin (non‑CYP3A4) if CK rises or if patient is on other CYP3A4 inhibitors.

assumptions_warnings: eGFR not provided – assumed ≥60 mL/min/1.73 m² for safe ACE‑I and metformin use; order serum creatinine/eGFR before titrating lisinopril or initiating metformin.
Baseline liver function tests (ALT/AST, bilirubin) and CK not available – required before starting high‑dose atorvastatin; obtain labs first.
Pregnancy status unknown – ACE‑I is teratogenic; confirm patient is not pregnant and advise effective contraception.
Allergy history not documented – verify no ACE‑I or statin hypersensitivity before prescribing.
Smoking and alcohol use not recorded – assess and provide cessation support as part of cardiovascular risk reduction.
QRISK score unavailable – LDL is markedly elevated, justifying statin therapy per NICE CG181 regardless of calculated risk.
treatment_summary: Continue lisinopril 10 mg daily and add amlodipine 5 mg daily to achieve target BP. Initiate high‑intensity atorvastatin 80 mg nightly for severe dyslipidaemia, and start metformin 500 mg twice daily to prevent diabetes progression. Monitor BP, renal function, electrolytes, liver enzymes, CK and glucose as per NICE NG136 and CG181 recommendations, and address lifestyle factors (diet, weight, exercise, smoking cessation).
